source_clause: W0.) The Comfort widget will have two screens: Comfort and Seats.
reasoning: 驗證目標：18.1（W0）與 17.1 之條文**逐字相同**，定出 Comfort widget 具兩個畫面（Comfort 與 Seats），三個 037 leaf 與 `17.1` 之 `124-01`／`124-02`／`124-03` **逐條對位**（畫面數／第一頁之身分／第二頁之身分），故照其測法寫三條（97 §2.7）；**本節此前停下**（批次 8，理由為「章標題不是條文，故螢幕尺寸之 PC 連出處都沒有，不補則與 17.1 全同」），97 §2.7／98 §1 裁定生成。**其 PC 之出處須具名為何物**：`10.25" Home screen` 出自 SR24 export 之**章標題** —— **此為全語料唯一一處 PC 之出處為章標題而非條文句子者**，已逐字記於 `gap_tcs.py` 之 `PC_1025`，使它日後不被讀成一般用法；其功能即區辨本節與 17.1，故 `duplicate_of` 不填（§10.6 之四項嚴格等價中 verification target 相異：所驗者為該螢幕上之 widget），**惟三條之 `test_item`／`test_procedure`／`expected_result` 與 17.1 三條逐字相同**，已入 `pending_sibling.tsv` 之 `equivalent_tc_pairs` 並具名為本包之發現。關鍵情境條件：同 17.1 —— `129-01`／`129-03` 另取第十六軸（Comfort Features 有無，出處 17.3），`129-02` 不取（第一頁為 Comfort，其存在不依賴座椅類配備）；依 **R-C34** 第九／十三軸與 EMEA 暴露 → 補。為什麼這樣切：三者之失效可各自獨立發生（畫面數對而內容錯、或 Seats 頁缺）；刻意略過：**18.1 之 full_text 不含 17.1 尾端之「(Refer to the Comfort – Front Comfort/Climate and Comfort – Heated/Vented Seats HMI sections for complete logic.)」** —— 故 `17.1` 之 R-C39 討論於本節不適用，三條同樣只驗兩個畫面之存在與其名稱而不驗其內容（§8.2.1），另依 **R-C17**，首頁之頁面管理行為定義於 Home Screen spec，不寫入本批

distinguishing_axis.delta: -463 = 畫面之數目（two）；-464 = 第一頁之身分（Comfort）；-465 = 第二頁之身分（Seats）。與 17.1 之 -115／-116／-117 之區辨在 PC 之螢幕（10.25"），其 verification target 因而相異，`duplicate_of` 不填

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: head unit 首頁上之 Comfort widget（其兩個畫面之存在與名稱），螢幕為 10.25"
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 6.3 使 comfort section 自 head unit 移除，而 widget 即在 head unit 首頁
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab；2.1 之 tabs 屬 climate 主類別，非首頁 widget
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車無 HVAC 畫面／popup，出處 2.14）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: 補排除 —— ch16 十八節無任何 widget 條文（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch18 側全無列）；依 R-C36-1 逐條之答為「ch16 無對應句」，已記於各 TC 之 `emea_ics_review`

tcs.tc_title: Comfort widget has two screens on the 10.25" screen
tcs.test_item:
W0.) The Comfort widget will have two screens: Comfort and Seats.

(move through the Comfort widget screens until the first screen is shown again -> Two widget screens were shown)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The Comfort widget is shown on the home screen
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle has the 10.25" head unit screen, the screen whose Comfort widget chapter 18 states (18.1)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with Comfort features, such as heated/vented seats and a heated steering wheel (17.3)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
6. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the home screen
2. Move through the Comfort widget screens until the first screen is shown again
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Comfort widget is displayed
2. Two widget screens were shown
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
